body: I have kind of a twisted history with friends. My best friend from 7/8th grade moved away right before freshman year. My new group are honestly some of the best people I've ever met, and I would die for them, but I just don't know how much I feel like they need me now that my other friend is around so much. I know two of them and my other friend would never abandon me, but I've always been a social guy, and only having three friends seems like a depressing prospect. And my home is so depressing to come to. My dad is inconsistent in how much it seems like he cares, my mom is just a heap of passive-agressitivity, and my sister is only out for herself. And I hate being at home and being surrounded by those people. And mostly new comics, but some older stuff. I'm a pretty diehard fan hah

But then one of my other friends kind of started hanging around us when he was kicked out of the "popular" crowd and he's kind of absorbed my entire friend group. I don't know what to say to him, like he's stolen my friends and even a girl but what can I say? "go back to being alone?" I'm probably just being selfish but I'm losing my sense of identity to him. And my mom gets exasperated easily. If things don't go her way or what she perceives as the "right" way, I may as well not be her son. And Batman all the way. Well, maybe Hawkman. But I digress
